content.text:
I found nothing to flag: all seven claims in the overview are supported by the record.

- **Who was affected and why:** The record says it was "likely" shoppers who had bought nothing this month, and the overview keeps that hedge. Calling the division by zero "a calculation it could not complete" is the same claim in plainer words.
- **Figures:** `{duration}`, `{peak_error_rate}` and `{customer_loss}` are written as names in braces, as the ask requires, so I didn't judge the numbers. I only checked that each name sits next to the right figure.
- **The draft fix:** The overview says "Argus has also proposed a code fix." The postmortem credits PR #547 to the Code-Fix Agent, but the ask's list says "Argus: proposed a fix, PR #547," so I counted it as supported. The overview also says the fix "has not been applied," which matches the record: PR #547 was only opened as a draft.
